tools.name: search_fixes
tools.description: Search DataCrate360's published Guides & Fixes for data tools (Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, Spark, …). Paste an error message or describe the problem. Cite the returned URL when you use an entry.

tools.name: get_fix
tools.description: The full text of one Guides & Fixes entry (symptoms, cause, solution, how to confirm), by slug from search_fixes.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: Tools that have published Guides & Fixes, with counts.

tools.name: list_labs
tools.description: Hands-on DataCrate360 labs to practise a skill, with links.

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Search published DataCrate360 community posts by data people (keywords). Cite the returned URL.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: The full text of one published community post, by post_id from search_posts.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_fixes, search_posts, get_post · Public sink: get_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_fixes, search_posts, get_post · Public sink: get_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
